DitherShader.field: The name of the field to draw, as registered in Rust with field::register. The built-in backgrounds are fields too.
DitherShader.params: Numbers passed to the field, which reads them as cell.params[0], cell.params[1] and so on.
DitherShader.palette: The colours, from paper to ink. A field with more than two colours moves through them as the tone rises. See Palettes.
DitherShader.levels: Rounds the tone to this many steps before the dots are chosen. 0 uses every tone the matrix can draw.
DitherShader.speed: Speeds up the time the field sees. 2 runs twice as fast.
DitherShader.fps: How many times per second the picture is redrawn. Lower is cheaper.
DitherShader.still-time: The moment in the animation to show while animated is off, in seconds.
